correctPoints: States that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
Correctly identifies that when object A exerts a force on object B, object B exerts an equal and opposite force back on object A, clarifying that the forces act on different objects.
groundingQuote: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction when object A exerts a force on object B, object B exerts an equal and opposite force back on object A.
feedback: Excellent work! You have accurately stated Newton's third law of motion, including the crucial detail that the action and reaction forces act on different objects.
